name: What a Show!
source:
You follow Alice, an aloof 19 year old who awakes in a mysterious theatre. Beside him, a rather eccentric boy yaps away, and in front of him, a large stage looms. Everything defies logic.

Will the two ever get out, or does Fate have a different plan in store?

A psychological romance visual novel about letting go and moving on... or not...

[From [url=https://six2eight.itch.io/what-a-show]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你跟随爱丽丝，一个冷漠的19岁女孩，她在一个神秘的剧院里醒来。在他身边，一个颇为古怪的男孩狂吠着，在他的面前，一座巨大的舞台若隐若现。一切都违背逻辑。

两人最终能否脱身，还是命运另有计划？

一部关于放手并继续前进……或不……的心理浪漫视觉小说

[来自[url=https://six2eight.itch.io/what-a-show]itch.io[/url]]
